server.description: The workshop's learned side: fit a model on a task's telemetry (the fit job), look at an ONNX file, check it against its contract with the board's rules
server.instructions: Fit writes the model and its contract under models/<name>/ of the task; check the contract before proposing. Nothing here judges: the twin does, on the station's request.

fit.title: Fit a model on a task's telemetry
fit.description: Run the fit job on a telemetry file of the task: a fit spec (version 1, job fit, model affine-residual, dataset.file relative to the task, fullScale, domain, monitor, outputs.file) as specs/*.json hold them. Writes the ONNX file, its contract (the board's vocabulary) and the fit report under models/<name>/ in the task; returns the coefficients, the quality (rows, kept, rmse, worst error), the parity check and the sha256 of the model. A dataset that is missing or empty is refused with the reason.

properties.taskId: the task whose directory holds the files
properties.spec: the fit spec; dataset.file is relative to the task's directory

inspect.title: Look at an ONNX file
inspect.description: Load an ONNX file of the task the way the board does, with no expectation: its sha256, size, and the names of its inputs and outputs; the loader's error when it cannot be loaded.

properties.path: the ONNX file, relative to the task

contract.title: Check an ONNX file against its contract
contract.description: Check an ONNX file of the task against a contract with exactly the board's rules (loadModelValidated): sha256 when given, the first input's shape, the output count, the first output's shape (a dimension <= 0 matches anything). Returns ok or the reason, as the board would.

properties.path: the ONNX file, relative to the task
properties.contractPath: a contract.json of the task, instead of contract

model://fits.name: Fits
model://fits.description: Every fit this slot ran: task, name, sha256, rmse, worst error, wall time
